verdict.rationale: Any software project could publish llms.txt or agent-oriented docs, so this axis applies to an open-source inference engine like llama.cpp. The evidence pack covers CLI and server usage, hardware backends, quantization, build guides and community performance reports, but never mentions an llms.txt file or documentation written for agents. With no evidence for this applicable capability, the verdict is none.
